answer_1.quote: We consider four prominent tasks in NLG: paraphrase generation, style transfer (formality), summarization, and question generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated paraphrases, style-transferred texts, summaries, and questions

answer_2.quote: We use standard automatic metrics to evaluate the tasks, as summarized in Table . For paraphrase generation we use iBLEU ; for summarization and question generation, we use ROUGE-L , and BLEU , respectively. To evaluate the formality transfer task, we follow  and use G-Score, the geometric mean of the formality score and BERTScore ;
